# quantms Portal

> Quantitative proteomics data portal. Standardized mass spectrometry datasets reanalyzed with the quantms pipeline and distributed in QPX format.

## Collections

- MS-Net: 107 datasets, 53 species, 500M+ PSMs. URL: https://portal.quantms.org/collections/msnet
- Single Cell Proteomics: 6 datasets, 538 single-cell samples. URL: https://portal.quantms.org/collections/single-cell

## Data Access

- Collections: https://publish.quantms.org/collections and https://publish.quantms.org/collections/{collection}
- Dataset catalogue (search, paginated): https://api.quantms.org/dataset-search/datasets?page=1&page_size=50
- Dataset detail: https://api.quantms.org/dataset-search/datasets/{accession}
- Portal statistics: https://browse.quantms.org/quantms/apps/statistics/stats.json
- MCP for AI agents: https://publish.quantms.org/mcp/ (collections) and https://api.quantms.org/{dataset-search,peptide-search,qpx-explore,compass}/mcp
- FTP root: https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/pride/resources/proteomes/

## Cancer Cell Line Proteome

- App: https://portal.quantms.org/apps/cell-lines
- Per protein: presence and within-study rank (level 4) across cancer cell lines, lineages and cancer types; RNA (DepMap, HPA) as an external reference; validated co-expression network
- Shareable URLs: https://portal.quantms.org/apps/cell-lines?tab=protein&gene=VIM

## Baseline Expression

- Protein expression browser: https://portal.quantms.org/baseline
- Tissue expression data: 15,782 proteins across 30+ human tissues (iBAQ log2)
- Shareable URLs: https://portal.quantms.org/baseline?proteins=P50851,Q96HS1

## Dataset Identifiers

Datasets use ProteomeXchange accessions (PXD prefix), iProX identifiers (IPX prefix), or MassIVE accessions (MSV prefix). Each dataset links to raw data, SDRF metadata, and processed files on the PRIDE FTP.

## Tools

- quantms pipeline: https://github.com/bigbio/quantms (DDA proteomics)
- quantmsdiann: https://github.com/bigbio/quantmsdiann (DIA proteomics)
- mokume: https://github.com/bigbio/mokume (protein quantification)
- qpx: https://github.com/bigbio/quantms.io (data format conversion)
- pmultiqc: https://github.com/bigbio/pmultiqc (QC reports)

## Citation

If you use this data, cite: Dai C, et al. quantms: a cloud-based pipeline for quantitative proteomics. Nature Methods. 2024;21:1603-1607. DOI: 10.1038/s41592-024-02343-1
